"least amount of code complexity" is key here and might be missed by many. Sometimes you find a higher number of lines of code is less complex. Why? Design Pattern abuse can reduce the lines-of-code so much a human can no longer understand what is actually executing and when. Tweet by @gdb

1606507011906101248.a: I am not sure we should be willing to take the training wheels off of AI when designing software. That is, I don't think we should generally allow it to generate code humans cannot understand. AI should help programmers write code and understand how existing code really works.

1606507650358853632.a: For example, pairing an AI algorithm with a debugger might help a human understand a program that uss difficult to follow design patterns to optimize performance and/or reduce code. Breaking the program flow into a diagram or whatever helps visualize the execution paths.
